about: I am a concept artist, character artist and Environment illustrator with 4 Years of industry experience. Co-Founder of an Indie Game Dev Studio; Miracle doors Studio. Experienced in Character creation, Concept art, environment illustration, storyboarding and animatics for narrative-driven Audiovisual projects. Strong Drawing and Illustration skills with a good foundation of anatomy, composition and visual clarity.
